text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At a hot spring inn in Oedo Town. Saren and {0} had changed into their traditional kimono and were relaxing in the guest room.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーエド町の温泉旅館にて。
サレンと{0}は和服に着替え、客室でくつろいでいた。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh... I feel like I'm going to get addicted to this kind of comfort...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～……
この寝心地、
癖になりそう……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: The feel of touching the underlying tatami is so nice... It heals me from the core of my body, and it feels like all the fatigue from everyday life melts away...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
タタミの感触って
いいわよね～……
体の芯から癒されて、
日頃の疲れが
とけていくみたい……♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Come on, don't hold back. You should try lying down, too, okay? If I keep going like this by myself, it'll look like I'm the only one lazing around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら遠慮しないで、
あんたも
寝転がってみたら？
このままだと、
あたしだけが
だらけてるみたいじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: It's rare to have the chance to relax like this. Especially for you, with so much work and adventures crammed into your schedule.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなにゆっくりできる機会なんて、
なかなかないでしょ。
特にあんたは、
日ごろから仕事を詰め込みすぎだものね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I'm going to relax and not think about work on my part. I want to spend some quality time with you alone, just us two...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしもいまは
仕事のことを考えずに、
のんびりするわ。
あんたと二人きり、
水入らずの時間を……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, maybe that's not the most appropriate way to describe it... Ah, geez, I'm getting self-conscious because the kids kept pestering us saying weird things...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっいや、
水入らずっていうのは
単にそういう表現で……
あぁ
もう、
あの子たちが変なこと言うから
意識しちゃうわね……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: But are you really okay with that? It's fine if you wanted to pick something you had fun with amongst yourselves, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
本当にいいの？
自分たちで遊べるものでも
いいのよ？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. Making Mama Saren happy is what we all decided to aim for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ。
ママ・サレンに喜んでもらうのだって、
僕たちのやりたいことだもん。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: If it's with {0} Onii-chan, then Mama Saren would surely be happy like a married couple. Take your time, okay♪?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃんと一緒だったら、
ママ・サレンもうれしいもんね。
水入らずでごゆっくり～、
だよ♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: A-As if we're married? Wait, we're not really...
text_block_list.orig_text:
み、
水入らず？
待って、
あたしたちは別にそんな……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: This is a New Year's gift from us to Mama Saren who always works so hard. Have lots of fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつも頑張ってくれてるママ・サレンに、
僕たちからお年玉、
だよ。
いーっぱい楽しんできてねっ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Seriously, where did they even learn to become so considerate... That said, I can't believe that such kids who were so lonely and desperate whenever they arrived at my doorstep grew up to become so responsible and kindhearted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
どこであんな気遣いを覚えたんだか……
でも、
うちに来たばっかりの時は
寂しくて
泣いてばっかりだった子が
こんなふうに成長するなんてね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: They're also happy to help around with cleaning... I feel more confident in being called "Mama Saren" by the children now♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
大掃除の手伝いもそうだけど、
うれしいわ。
子どもたちのママ・サレンとして、
あたしも自信が持てそう♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Y-You think so? But maybe you're right... Even if we're not related by blood, I don't think that our bond and feelings are any different from a standard family.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうかしら？
でも、
そうね……
血がつながってなくても、
気持ちは親子と
変わらないつもりよ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...As if. I'm always tormented by worries that I'm not able to set a proper role model for those kids. I feel like I'm causing them a lot of trouble on a daily basis.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて。
だけど
子どもたちのお手本になれてるのかっていうと
自信は全然ないんだけどね。
みんなには、
普段から苦労をかけちゃってるって思うし。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: You're right... It's thanks to everyone back home that we're here able to experience such a wonderful time. I guess I'll just do my best to be more reliable♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね……
みんなのおかげで、
こんなに素敵な時間を過ごせてるんだもの。
あたしも
もっとしっかりできるよう
頑張るわ♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Heehee. I think that makes more sense. You're always so kind, always acting for the sake of others. I'm sure that your role model is one that they follow hearthily...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
そっちの方が納得かもね。
どこまでもお人よしで、
いつも誰かのために動くような人だもの。
きっと
あの子たちも、
そんなあんたを見習って……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...You're making it sound like they're our kids by wording it like that! Don't say such embarrassing things with a straight face!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って言い方だとまるで
あたしたちの子どもみたいじゃないの！
恥ずかしくなること、
真顔で言わないの！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Now then... It'd be a waste to just sit back and relax in this room. Since it's a New Year's gift from my kids, I have to enjoy this Oedo to the fullest♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
お部屋でゆっくりしてるだけじゃ
もったいないわよね。
子どもたちからのお年玉だもの、
このオーエドを
全力で楽しまなくちゃ♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: {0}. You know a lot about Oedo, don't you? You were talking to the innkeeper earlier...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんた、
オーエドにも
詳しいのよね？
さっき
宿の人と
話してたけど……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Just how far does the "{0} information network" extend exactly... Surely you don't have more connection than the average merchant by now, do you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の人脈って、
どこまで広がってるのよ……
そこいらの商人よりも
コネが多いんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! In that case, do you know anything about this city? You know, like some cool tourist spots or anything like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そうだわ！
それならもしかして、
この街のことにも
詳しかったりする？
ほら、
おすすめの
観光名所とか。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you. I don't mind exploring the city for the first time by myself, but the thought of exploring it with you sounds a lot better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ありがとうね。
初めての街を
探検するのもいいけど、
あんたと一緒に
ゆっくり楽しみたい気分なの。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Oh, but... Knowing this pattern, there's no telling if something unexpected won't happen again... We just had a hard time with that snake-related accident.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
でも……
また不測の事態が起きないとも
限らないわね……
蛇騒動で
大変な目に遭ったばっかりだし。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: N-No! It's nothing! Let's go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ううん！　
何でもないわ！
行きましょ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: There's no point in worrying all the time! We'll both be careful while having our fun. He's with me, after all... I'm sure it'll all be fine! Surely... right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配ばっかりしても
仕方がないわよね！
気を付けつつ
楽しみましょ。
こいつも一緒にいるんだし……
きっと
大丈夫よ！　
きっと、
ね！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm, delicious♪ This bitter tea and these little sweet snacks... they're complete opposites, but they complement each other...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん～っ、
おいしい♪
この渋いお茶と
小さな甘いお茶菓子……
正反対なのに
お互いを引き立てあって……

text_block_list.name: Owner of the Tea Shop
text_block_list.text: Wah!! Wh-What the hell is this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ！！　
な、
なんだこりゃ！！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: As soon as we get out, something happens...! What's wrong? Is something troubling you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっそく何か起こったわね……！
どうしましたか、
何か
困りごとでも？

text_block_list.name: Owner of the Tea Shop
text_block_list.text: Ah... look at this, young lady! I was just casually making some tea, but suddenly, five tea leaves are standing up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
見てくれよお嬢さん！
何気なく茶を淹れただけなんだが、
茶柱が
５本も立ってるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: T-Tea leaves? Ah, that's certainly amazing... It looks like something incredibly lucky is going to happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃ、
茶柱？
あぁ、
確かに
すごいですね……
とてつもなくラッキーなことが起こりそう。

text_block_list.name: Tourist Woman
text_block_list.text: Geez, how long are you going to drag me around?! I'm tired from crossing through all those crowds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
いつまで連れまわすのよ！
人混みばっかで疲れたんだってば！

text_block_list.name: Tourist Man
text_block_list.text: D-Don't say that... We're enjoying our trip to Oedo.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなこと言わないでよ……
せっかくのオーエド旅行じゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: That's... it seems someone's arguing! Maybe I should mediate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは……
誰かが
言い争ってるみたい！
仲裁した方がいいかしら。

text_block_list.name: Tourist Man
text_block_list.text: I made this plan because I wanted to entertain you, honey. Look, there are still a lot of tourist attractions we haven't seen yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハニーを楽しませたくて、
予定を立てたんだ。
ほら、
まだ見てない観光名所がたくさんあるよ。

text_block_list.name: Tourist Woman
text_block_list.text: I don't care about any of that! More importantly... I want to be alone with Darling as soon as possible!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなの、
別にそこまで見たくないもん！
それより……
早くダーリンと
二人きりになりたいの！！

text_block_list.name: Tourist Man
text_block_list.text: ...HAH!! My bad, HONEY, I was such a fool! I can't believe I didn't realize my beloved's true wish... Our plans are now clear, let's go back to the inn right away!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！！　
ごめんハニー、
僕が愚かだった！
愛する君の本当の願いに気付かないなんて……
予定なんかいいや、
すぐに宿に戻ろう！！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Umm, well... I suppose that's an original way to resolve a love quarrel? A-Anyway, it doesn't look like there's any need to interfere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと……
手の込んだ
惚気？
と、
とにかく、
横から口を出すことじゃ
ないみたいね……

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: うええぇぇんっ！！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: A child is crying...! A clear premonition of an upcoming accident. Hearing what she has to say comes first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子どもが泣いてる……！
事件の予感ね。
まずは
話を聞いてあげましょう。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, dear, what's going on? Did something sad happen?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇあなた、
どうしたの？
何か
悲しいことがあったのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I want to eat some cotton candy... But why does buying cotton candy mean my New Year's gift money goes down as a result...? Is it true you can't get happiness in life without making sacrifices...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ……
わたし、
わたあめが食べたいのに……
どうしてわたあめ買ったら、
お年玉が減っちゃうの……？
幸せを、
犠牲なしに得ることはできないの……？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Mmmm, I see... I don't think you should be seeing it as a sacrifice. The shopkeeper will be happy for the money he received from you, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
そうね……
犠牲だなんて
考えなければいいんじゃないかしら。
あなたがお金を払った分、
お店の人も
幸せになるんだから。
ね？

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Really? By paying, I will make the people at the store happy too...? Then I'll... buy cotton candy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなの？　
お店の人も幸せ……？
じ
ゃあ、
わたし……
わたあめ買う！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Saren and {0} enjoyed their time in the city of Oedo, despite encountering some minor trifling incidents.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてサレンと{0}は、
ささやかな小さな事件に出くわしつつも、
オーエドの街を楽しんだ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And then, that night. Saren was lost in thought while soaking in the open-air bath at the inn.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして、
その日の夜。
サレンは旅館の露天風呂に浸かりながら、
物思いにふけっていた。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Aaah, this feels so good... We've been walking here and there a lot, and my body has gotten cold all over. Now I'm in hot water, which is also perfect for a tired body...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～、
気持ちいい……
たくさん外を歩いて、
体中冷え切っていたものね。
熱いくらいのお湯だけど、
疲れた体には
ちょうどいいわ……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: .......No, I mean, why am I even so tired. I finally got to spend time with {0} on this trip......and I should have been able to rest as much as I wanted......
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………いや、
なんで疲れてるのよ
あたし。
せっかくの旅行で、
{0}と一緒に過ごせて……
思う存分
休めたはずなのに……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...I should know the reason why. I ended up worrying about whether there was any trouble around me... I didn't act like I was relaxing while alone with him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……理由は分かってる。
周りでトラブルがないかって、
結局
気になっちゃって……
あいつと二人っきりでのんびりって感じじゃなかったもの。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez... It was supposed to be a special time with him the kids gave me as a present...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
もう……
子どもたちがプレゼントしてくれた、
特別な時間だったのに……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I wish we could have just spent more time together without worrying about what was going on around us... It seems my habit for sticking my nose into things didn't help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りのことなんて気にしないで、
もっと二人で
ゆっくりすればよかったのよね……
つい、
癖で
首を突っ込んじゃうけど。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: As for him... I wonder how he felt about it. I wonder if I said or did something unnecessary to the point he didn't enjoy himself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつは、
どうだったかしら。
あたしが余計なこと言ったせいで、
あいつまで
楽しめなかったりしたら……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ahh, no, no good. I can't stop thinking negatively. Maybe I should just get up and cool my head...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
ダメダメ。
なんか
悪い方向にばっかり考えちゃう。
さっさと上がって、
頭を冷やした方がいいかも……

text_block_list.name: サレン
text_block_list.text:
……あれ？
なんか、
頭が
ふわふわ
するよう
な……？
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
なんか、
頭が
ふわふわ
するよう
な……？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? This is...? When did I... come back to my room...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
ここは……？
あたし、
いつの間に……
部屋に戻ってきたの……？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Ah, {0}... Um...that's right, I got out of the bath... What happened after that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
{0}……
えっと……
そうだわ、
あたしは
お風呂から上がって……
その後、
どうしたんだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see... I was thinking about something while taking a bath, and ended up overstaying my welcome in the bath instead...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そっか……
お風呂に入りながら考え事してたら、
つい
長湯しちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, {0}... For causing you this unnecessary trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい、
{0}……
迷惑
かけちゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: No... That's not all. Even while we were sightseeing during the day... I think it's because of me and my actions that you're getting even more tired. You ran around under my assumptions of trouble being afoot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん……
それだけじゃないわ。
昼間の
観光だって……
あたしのせいで、
あんたまで余計に
疲れさせちゃったかも。
トラブルかもって
走り回って。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I should have just enjoyed myself more without worrying about such things... Then you... could have enjoyed yourself too. I'm sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこと気にせずに
もっと素直に楽しめばよかったわ……
そうすれば
あんただって……
楽しめたのに。
ごめんね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: You say that... But there's no real need to be so considerate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたは、
そんなこと言って……
別に
気を遣わなくたっていいのよ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Huh...? No way, but... It was a special trip for just the two of us, you know? Are you really satisfied with just that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
そんな、
でも……
せっかくの旅行で、
二人きりの
特別な時間だったのよ？
そんなので
満足なの？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...I see. If you say so, then... I think I'll try to enjoy what we did today too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そっか。
あんたがそう言ってくれるなら、
あたしも……
今日のこと、
楽しかったって
思えそう。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you, {0}. I feel like hearing your feelings has made my heart feel lighter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ありがとう、
{0}。
あんたの気持ちが聞けたら、
心が軽くなった気がするわ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Even if there's nothing special about it... Ordinary everyday life days like those are fun if the two of us are together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に、
特別なことがなくたって……
何気ない日常だって、
二人一緒なら
楽しいものね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: We work hard, we take care of the children... Sometimes we have a little extravagant time like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
頑張って働いて、
子どもたちの世話をして……
たまにこんなふうに、
ちょっと贅沢な時間を
過ごしたりして……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: The time I spend with you will no longer be something special, but something natural... Then, every day will be so much fun... If such a future were to bloom between us, it would be really wonderful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたと一緒に過ごす時間が、
特別じゃなくて
当たり前になって……
そしたら、
とっても楽しい毎日になりそう……
そんな未来が来たら、
本当にすてきだわ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I... believe I still might be a little dizzy... I'm saying something a little embarrassing, aren't I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたし、
まだ
のぼせちゃってるかも……
なんか、
恥ずかしいこと
言ってる、
わよね……？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ、
でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by the night wind, the two of them chatted without anyone getting in their way. Oedo's peaceful night wore on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夜風に包まれながら、
誰にも邪魔されずに語り合う二人。
オーエドの穏やかな夜は、
更けていくのだった……
